items.html: *And now we shall explain the building of the Nukva of ZA. For behold, when the time of the emanation of the Tifferet of ZA arrived, as above, he immediately pierced an opening in the back of his Chazeh, and there the head of the Nukva was emanated, as mentioned in the Idra Rabba. And the matter is that ZA is included of ten Sefirot when he joins with Malchut; however, even now, at this time, which is the beginning of her emanation, this Malchut has only its tenth part alone, and it is called only the aspect of a small point, as is known. And afterward the Emanator began to correct her and enlarge her and make her a complete Partzuf, included of ten Sefirot, by means of the nine points that he added to her, as mentioned.
